title: ItipStructure
description: ITIP base Archetype for Structure — the foundational dynamic aggregate. Inherits gsm/Structure through the top-level $ref and composes the ITIP-wide ItipAscription facet through allOf. Every non-Archetype Structure statement distributed in an ITIP framework MUST be typed by this Archetype or one of its descendants, never directly by gsm/Structure, which carries no framework membership vocabulary. Source: ITIP (framework foundation).
